{{recipesummary|category=Cookie recipes|yield=About a dozen and a half|time=15 minutes|difficulty=1}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Holiday Recipes|Holiday Recipes]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

'''Choco-crunch bites''' are a type of no-bake [[Cookbook:Confections|confection]] bound with peanut butter.

==Ingredients==

=== Base ===
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (100 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 3.5 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Sunflower Seeds|sunflower seeds]]
* 1 cup (80 g / 2.8 oz) [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]], [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]]
* 1 cup (80 g / 2.8 oz) mini-[[Cookbook:Chocolate Chips|chocolate chips]]
* ¼ cup (15 g / 0.5 oz) puffed rice cereal
* ¾ cup (225 g / 7.9 oz) [[Cookbook:Peanut Butter|peanut butter]]

===Topping===

* ½ cup (60 g / 2.1 oz) [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|powdered sugar]] or 1 cup (80 g / 2.8 oz) [[Cookbook:Coconut|coconut]]
==Procedure==

# Mix all ingredients except the topping together.
# Form into 1-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] balls by pressing the mixture firmly together with clean hands.
# Gently roll in either the powdered sugar or coconut.
# Cover and refrigerate any leftovers.
